tabs.html:
MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution specifically designed for MikroTik networking hardware. It combines a 128GB solid-state drive (SSD) with a pre-installed RouterOS v6.48, providing a reliable and efficient storage medium for MikroTik routers and servers. This SSD is compatible with MikroTik’s Legacy BIOS boot mode and is built to work seamlessly with PC MikroTik machines, making it an ideal choice for users looking to optimize their network infrastructure. It supports various MikroTik server machines, ensuring flexibility and compatibility across different configurations. With 128GB of storage capacity, this SSD provides ample space for network configurations, logs, and software updates. The drive also offers version update and downgrade support, giving users the ability to easily upgrade or revert to different versions of RouterOS. It comes pre-installed with RouterOS version v6.48, and it can be updated to version v6.49.14, ensuring users benefit from the latest features and security improvements. The MikroTik Level 6 license is pre-activated, providing full access to advanced features, including routing, firewall, VPN services, and more, making this SSD ideal for users who require a professional-grade networking solution. The SSD’s robust performance helps ensure the smooth operation of RouterOS, offering faster data access, improved reliability, and efficient management of network traffic. Additionally, the product includes technical and warranty support, offering peace of mind with reliable customer service and protection against defects. Whether you're managing a small office network or a large enterprise environment, the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD provides a solid and dependable foundation for MikroTik routers running RouterOS.

Features of the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 128GB SSD

  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • Legacy BIOS Boot Mode
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v6.48 Pre-Install
  • OS Version v6.49.14 Update
  • Technical and Warranty Support

This SSD is a great solution for users looking for a high-quality, pre-configured storage drive for their MikroTik routers and servers.
